row.notes: myteam-g2: Team HQ state enter/exit helper: resets the HQ sub-state (FUN_140df1ec0 at +0x1110) and posts the messages team_hq_set_scene, start_hq_flow, team_hq_enable_pause and is_masked_tutorial_playing_message on the bus (global 0x14618b3b8 +8); on error paths records code 0x58 in the thread error stack. Hook: posting team_hq_enable_pause lets a mod pause/unpause HQ time. DISPUTE(V9020) role per verifier: It does not post messages. After resetting +0x1110, with flag!=0 it calls Ne_Subscribe_BusMessage (0x143987810) and with flag==0 Ne_Unsubscribe (0x143988350, confirmed by the Bank unsubscribe site) for four names with delegates {callback, state}: FUN_143703370, FUN_143703d40 (Ui_EnterMyTeamCareer_Main), 0x1436ffac0, 0x1436ffad0; stores the flag at state+0x1244. So it is the Team HQ state subscribe/unsubscribe of those four messages.
